purpose: Final dark conversion band before the footer, home only

responsive.phone: Background art is a static, in-flow image (no absolute positioning); card content stacked with a dark inner background.
responsive.tablet: Background art becomes absolutely positioned/scaled (desktop-only rule actually applies from desktop up -- see desktop column); content gap widens (tablet:gap-[50px]) and gets a tablet-specific dark background (tablet:bg-ink) on the content block itself.
responsive.desktop: Background art becomes absolutely positioned, vertically centered and right-anchored (desktop:top-1/2 desktop:-translate-y-1/2 desktop:right-0) with a fixed aspect ratio (desktop:aspect-[3.44828]); heading steps to desktop:text-h3; outer bottom padding grows (desktop:pb-[120px]).
